summary: Snowshare is a self-hosted platform designed for sharing files, short URLs, and text snippets. It includes features such as adjustable expiration times, privacy controls, and QR code generation for shared items.
goodFor: It suits small teams or individuals who want a single, self-hosted interface for handling quick file transfers, pastebin tasks, and link shortening.
watchOut: With a modest repository size and steady maintenance score, it may lack the extensive community support and plugin ecosystem found in more established alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged with Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for uploaded data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
